items.label_ar: سحب الزمن إلى الطين السابق للحكاية

luna_art_direction.art_direction_ar: توجيه فني محلي لبطاقة عنوان. الأولوية لدقة النص العربي، التكوين الهادئ، والتحول المادي من الشق إلى الطين، دون مولد صور أو عناصر بشرية.

cinematic_blueprint.action: Begin with a deep charcoal field containing a narrow horizontal slit of antique-gold light. Reveal the Arabic title "سراج" cleanly from within the slit. Transition the slit into a wet clay trace that carries the episode title, ending with both title hierarchy and clay texture legible.
cinematic_blueprint.atmosphere: Restrained tactile title reveal, archival and elemental, with no decorative particles beyond subtle clay moisture.
cinematic_blueprint.camera: No simulated camera movement. Use authored 2.5D layer motion only: a minimal depth shift between charcoal background, light slit, clay trace, and typography; no template zoom.
cinematic_blueprint.color_palette: Deep charcoal black, antique gold, warm parchment highlights, and dark wet-clay brown.
cinematic_blueprint.composition: Centered primary title hierarchy with generous negative space; the slit begins as the sole visual anchor, then becomes the clay trace. Keep all typography inside safe margins and preserve a calm asymmetrical balance.
cinematic_blueprint.continuity: SEQ-01 visual identity; no character location; key light direction implied from frame left; palette CHARCOAL_ANTIQUE_GOLD_WARM_PARCHMENT_SYMBOLIC, material language, scale, and left-to-right reveal logic remain consistent.
cinematic_blueprint.environment: A graphic field built from charcoal texture and wet clay material, not a literal location.
cinematic_blueprint.lens: Not applicable to local graphics; use orthographic compositing and controlled 2.5D depth.
cinematic_blueprint.lighting: A narrow soft-edged antique-gold light slit enters from frame left; clay receives a restrained warm highlight, with no visible source or volumetric fantasy effect.
cinematic_blueprint.materials: Fine charcoal grain, wet clay with shallow ridges and realistic specular moisture, parchment-like restrained lettering finish.
cinematic_blueprint.safety: Typography and abstract materials only; no sacred figure, face, body, unseen being, or representational religious entity.
cinematic_blueprint.subject: Arabic title typography: primary "سراج", followed by the approved episode title text supplied by editorial.
cinematic_blueprint.temporal_motion: Ten-second graphic sequence: charcoal field and slit establish, "سراج" resolves with precise letterforms, the slit transforms into a wet clay trace, then the episode title appears and holds only as long as needed for readability; no morphing letters, jitter, blur, accidental glyphs, decorative zoom, or filler.
